headline: US Sanctions Accelerate China's Semiconductor Self-Reliance Drive, Fundamentally Reshaping Global Tech Dynamics
summary: US sanctions, intended to curb China's technological advancement, are reportedly backfiring, propelling Beijing's domestic semiconductor industry towards unprecedented self-sufficiency and market leadership. This accelerated drive threatens to create a bifurcated global tech supply chain, impacting everything from AI infrastructure to the competitive landscape for international chipmakers.
